en.title: Resident Evil 2 Remake Gets Incredible Couch Co-Op Mod
en.summary: The classic survival horror experience of Resident Evil 2 Remake can now be shared with a friend thanks to a dedicated modder. Dive back into Raccoon City with this new way to play.
en.body:
The terrifying streets of Raccoon City are once again drawing players in, and now there's an even more compelling reason to revisit **Resident Evil 2 Remake**. A talented modder, **Shopcreeper01**, has unleashed a fantastic new mod that brings local couch co-op to the game, allowing two players to tackle the zombie-infested nightmare together.

This isn't just a simple split-screen implementation; the "HUNK'y Friend" mod, as it's known, offers a robust multiplayer experience. Players can choose to team up as **Leon Kennedy** and **Claire Redfield**, or even swap in other characters like **HUNK** and fourteen others, experiencing the entire campaign side-by-side. The mod includes crucial features to streamline the cooperative gameplay, such as a quick access wheel for communication and actions, separate inventories for each player, adjustable difficulty settings, and a vital revive system to help your partner when they're down. For those who prefer a solo journey but still want a companion, the mod also allows for an AI-controlled partner, reminiscent of **Sheva Alomar** from **Resident Evil 5**, whose actions can be managed through an in-game communication menu.

## Bringing Raccoon City Co-Op to Life

For years, fans have dreamed of experiencing the tense atmosphere and challenging puzzles of **Resident Evil 2 Remake** with a friend. While the original game was a single-player affair, the success of mods for other titles has shown the incredible potential for community-driven enhancements. This particular mod stands out due to its depth and the care taken to integrate cooperative mechanics seamlessly. The ability to swap characters and control an AI companion adds a layer of replayability and customization that many players will undoubtedly appreciate. It transforms the solitary struggle for survival into a shared ordeal, amplifying the horror and the triumphs.

## A New Way to Survive the Outbreak

The mod's availability on platforms like NexusMods means that PC players can easily download and install it, bringing this enhanced cooperative experience to their gaming setups. The community's reaction has been overwhelmingly positive, with players eager to dive back into **Raccoon City** with this new feature. It’s a testament to the enduring appeal of **Resident Evil 2 Remake** and the dedication of its fanbase. This mod doesn't just add a feature; it fundamentally changes how players can engage with and enjoy one of the most acclaimed survival horror titles of the last decade.

## What's Next

While this mod is a fan-made creation and not officially sanctioned by **Capcom**, its popularity suggests a strong desire for official cooperative modes in future **Resident Evil** titles. Players can currently download the "HUNK'y Friend" mod and begin their co-op adventures on PC.

content_raw: Resident Evil 2 has been seeing a resurgence in players after the smashing success of the newest film, which makes sense given their similarly shared settings during the outbreak of Raccoon City. While Resident Evil 2's status as the best starting point and one of the highest-rated games in the franchise certainly helps, there is yet another incentive for players to flock to the game thanks to its newest multiplayer capabilities.
